# SirNukes Mod Support APIs (Nexus Mod 503 / Steam 2042901274)

## Overview
Provides Simple Menu API, Custom Options API, and pipe communications for custom Lua mods in X4: Foundations.

## Key APIs
- `Menus.Register_Menu(menu_def)`: Registers standalone custom UI menus with buttons, tables, dropdowns, and textboxes.
- `Menus.Open_Menu(menu_id, args)`: Opens a registered custom menu overlay.
